g.text: Reading: the human supplies and decides; the agents route the work through skills to tools; tools compute and come back as descriptor cards; the planner stops at every checkpoint and the human picks. Nothing the agents say is a number they computed.

g.text: extension, only if D2 allows DFT: dft_single_points · every tool returns its structure as a descriptor card and logs every parameter beside its output
The architecture: the human at both ends, three LLM agents that only plan, propose and draft, five skills they follow, nine tools that do every calculation
board of 21 October 2026 · arrows are calls and hand-offs · every number the agents report is a tool output · hooks block coordinate edits and pause at the checkpoints
